title: Question 7.1c: Testing Individual Reviews - Extracting Result
instruction: After making a prediction, we need to extract the actual prediction value from the dataset.
reveal: This code extracts the prediction value from the dataset. `.select("prediction")` gets just the prediction column, `.collectAsList()` brings it into memory as a list, and `.get(0)` gets the first (and only) row since we only predicted on one review. Then it handles the type (Integer or Double) to get the integer prediction value (0 or 1).
